name: CygnusX Variant Image Preview
author: sidefx00

sections.description:
CygnusX Variant Image Preview adds a simple admin interface for creating image preview sets and displaying them with a shortcode.

Each preview can include a default image, display size settings, optional maximum width, and multiple variants with labels, images, swatch colors, and URLs.

Plugin page: https://pluginhatch.com/downloads/variant-image-preview/

Author: Stephen Engelking

Author URI: https://www.cygnusx.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cygnusx-variant-image-preview folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate CygnusX Variant Image Preview through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Add a new Variant Preview in the WordPress admin.
  4. Copy the generated shortcode into a post, page, or template-supported content area.
sections.faq:
How do I display a preview?

Create a Variant Preview and use the shortcode shown in the editor.

Can variants use color swatches?

Yes. A variant can use a swatch color, a thumbnail image, or both an image and label.
